reproduction.rationale: Reproduction is an independent first-class outcome on the original full Figure 1 ten-realization, five-module sorting panel. Both conditions must receive identical original paper/activity/cohort/observations/metrics and budgets, with only pinned author code added for paper_data_author_code. Original serialized activity and output provenance, allowed-source exposure, code/input manifests, native scoring RNG, independent computation verification and cumulative access/resource policies are not frozen. Therefore no condition is admitted and no metadata-only or author replay result is promoted to an AI outcome.
